verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a home and business phone service, since such services can offer AI receptionists or assistants. However, the evidence documents no AI assistant to which users can delegate tasks. Related features such as automated check-in calls, voicemail transcription, spam blocking and call routing are adjacent automations, not a delegable AI assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
